note: うさひめ rabbit hop (ぴょんぴょん), faithful downscale of the approved reference, facing RIGHT (native: 1); mirror horizontally for left. 0 crouch, 1 push-off, 2 airborne peak, 3 landing. Lowest outline row 30 on ground frames 0,1,3; frame 2 airborne. Row 31 empty. Hop in place (game moves the actor).

frames.name: walk_0
frames.desc: crouch/gather: body squashed 1px (down 1px), all paws on the ground (lowest outline row 30)

frames.name: walk_1
frames.desc: push-off: body up 2px with a 1px stretch, hind legs lengthened 2px so the hind paws still push on row 30; front paws lifted

frames.name: walk_2
frames.desc: airborne peak: whole body up 3px, all paws off the ground

frames.name: walk_3
frames.desc: landing: body up 1px coming down, front legs lengthened 1px so the front paws touch down first (row 30), hind paws still in the air
